**How Turbonomic Helps Unilever Leverage AI for Multi‑Cloud Observability**

| Capability | What Turbonomic Brings | Why It Matters for Unilever |
|------------|------------------------|-----------------------------|
| **Unified Visibility Across All Clouds** | Aggregates real‑time telemetry (CPU, memory, I/O, network, latency) from GCP, AWS, Azure, on‑premises, and edge workloads into a single pane of glass. | Unilever can see the health of its global supply‑chain, retail, and consumer‑engagement services without switching dashboards. |
| **Predictive Capacity Planning** | Uses machine learning models to forecast demand spikes, seasonal peaks, or new product launches, and recommends right‑size resources before they become bottlenecks. | Enables proactive scaling for marketing campaigns, e‑commerce traffic, and data‑analytics pipelines. |
| **Automated Remediation & Optimization** | Continuously applies policies that move workloads, adjust quotas, or trigger autoscaling based on business rules (e.g., “keep latency < 200 ms for checkout services”). | Reduces manual toil for Unilever’s ops teams and ensures SLA compliance for critical customer touchpoints. |
| **Cost‑Aware Decision Making** | Calculates the cost impact of every policy change, including spot/Preemptible instances, reserved capacity, and hybrid‑cloud savings. | Gives finance visibility into where money is spent and where it can be saved while maintaining performance. |
| **Policy‑Based Governance** | Lets Unilever codify compliance, security, and sustainability requirements (e.g., “no public IPs for internal services”) and enforce them automatically. | Keeps regulatory obligations (GDPR, PCI‑DSS) and ESG goals (carbon‑footprint limits) in check. |
| **Multi‑Tenant & Role‑Based Access Control** | Supports separate namespaces for different business units (Retail, FMCG, Logistics) with granular permissions. | Allows each unit to manage its own workloads while still sharing insights at the corporate level. |

**Key Takeaway:** Turbonomic turns raw telemetry into actionable intelligence that drives both performance and cost efficiency across all of Unilever’s cloud environments.

---

### Difference Between Turbonomic and Native Cloud Provider Tools

| Feature | Turbonomic | GCP Operations Suite / Stackdriver | AWS CloudWatch / Cost Explorer | Azure Monitor / Advisor |
|---------|------------|------------------------------------|---------------------------------|--------------------------|
| **Scope** | Cross‑cloud + on‑prem + edge | Single‑provider | Single‑provider | Single‑provider |
| **Observability Depth** | Real‑time metrics + logs + traces + application dependency graphs | Metrics + logs + traces (but limited cross‑service correlation) | Metrics + logs + traces (mostly provider‑centric) | Metrics + logs + traces (mostly provider‑centric) |
| **AI/ML Layer** | Predictive capacity planning, anomaly detection, automated remediation | Basic alerting, no predictive modeling | Basic alerting, no predictive modeling | Basic alerting, no predictive modeling |
| **Automation** | Policy‑driven auto‑remediation, autoscaling, cost optimization | Manual scaling, limited automation via Cloud Functions / Lambda | Manual scaling, limited automation via Lambda | Manual scaling, limited automation via Logic Apps |
| **Cost Management** | Unified cost attribution, ROI calculations, multi‑currency support | Provider‑specific cost breakdown | Provider‑specific cost breakdown | Provider‑specific cost breakdown |
| **Governance** | Policy engine that spans multiple clouds, role‑based access, audit trails | Provider‑specific IAM + resource tagging | Provider‑specific IAM + resource tagging | Provider‑specific IAM + resource tagging |
| **Integration** | APIs, SDKs, connectors for Kubernetes, VMware, Hyper‑Scale, SaaS | Native integration only within the same provider | Native integration only within the same provider | Native integration only within the same provider |
| **Learning Curve** | One UI/CLI for all clouds | Multiple consoles per provider | Multiple consoles per provider | Multiple consoles per provider |
| **Use Case Fit** | Enterprise‑wide optimization, multi‑cloud strategy, compliance | Provider‑centric monitoring, basic alerting | Provider‑centric monitoring, basic alerting | Provider‑centric monitoring, basic alerting |

**Bottom Line:** While GCP, AWS, and Azure provide powerful native monitoring and cost tools, they operate in silos. Turbonomic stitches those silos together, adds AI‑driven insight, and automates actions across the entire stack—exactly what Unilever needs to keep its global operations running smoothly and cost‑efficiently.
